title: Java Full Stack Developer with Angular - Mid-level
description: Java and Angular fundamentals, Java data processing, full-stack failure handling and form design. 8 MCQs, 1 Java coding problem, 2 written responses.
reviewerInstructions: Score each written response against its rubric. Award points for specific, technically sound reasoning and trade-offs. Notes are optional. Publish only after every criterion is scored. The recommendation is a human judgment; this application does not make hiring decisions. Inspect submitted Java code and final tests before awarding code-quality points.

items.text: Which Java collection offers average O(1) lookup by key?
items.explanation: HashMap provides expected constant-time key lookup under a suitable hash distribution.

items.text: Which mechanism closes an AutoCloseable resource when its scope ends?
items.explanation: try-with-resources invokes close even when the body throws.

items.text: Which statement about volatile is correct?
choices: It makes every compound operation atomic
It provides visibility of writes across threads
It replaces synchronization in every case
items.correctAnswer: It provides visibility of writes across threads
items.explanation: Visibility does not make a read-modify-write sequence such as increment atomic.

items.text: Which HTTP method is defined as idempotent?
items.explanation: Repeating the same PUT request has the same intended resource effect.

items.text: What does unsubscribing from an in-progress Angular HttpClient request do?
items.explanation: Unsubscribing cancels an in-progress client request; it does not guarantee rollback of server-side work.

items.text: Which Angular forms approach defines the form model explicitly in component code?
items.explanation: Reactive forms use explicit FormControl and FormGroup models in component code.

items.text: A search field starts a new HTTP request for each value. Which RxJS operator switches to the latest inner request and unsubscribes from the previous one?
items.explanation: switchMap unsubscribes from the previous inner observable when a new value arrives.

items.text: Where must authorization for an order-update API be enforced?
choices: Only in an Angular route guard
In the backend for every protected request
items.correctAnswer: In the backend for every protected request
items.explanation: Client-side controls improve navigation, but the server must enforce authorization for protected resources.

items.text:
Duplicate customer IDs
Read 0 to 10,000 signed 32-bit integers from standard input, separated by whitespace. Print each ID that occurs more than once, once only, in ascending numeric order, separated by a single space. Print NONE if there are no duplicates.
Use Java 21 and a public class Main with a public static void main(String[] args). Do not use packages, files, network access or external libraries.
Example: input 4 2 4 3 2 gives output 2 4.

rubric.label: Approach and code quality
rubric.guidance: Assess correct data structures, handling of edge cases, sensible complexity, readable naming and concise explanation through code.

items.text: Design an Angular order-entry screen backed by a Spring Boot API. Explain client and server validation, duplicate submissions, authorization, failure feedback and testing.

rubric.label: End-to-end correctness
rubric.guidance: 0: no coherent flow. 1-5: basic form and endpoint. 6-8: client/server validation, server authorization and idempotency. 9-11: covers concurrent retries, transaction boundaries and integration tests.

rubric.label: Resilience and user experience
rubric.guidance: 0: no failure handling. 1-5: generic error display. 6-8: loading states, actionable errors, bounded retries and preserved form state. 9-11: covers accessibility, partial failures and observability.

items.text: An Angular typeahead shows stale results and a large list renders slowly. Explain how you would diagnose and improve correctness, rendering and accessibility.

rubric.label: Request lifecycle and correctness
rubric.guidance: 0: ignores request ordering. 1-5: suggests debounce only. 6-8: explains debounce, distinct values, switchMap cancellation and cleanup. 9-11: considers server-side effects, errors and tests for out-of-order responses.

rubric.label: Rendering and verification
rubric.guidance: 0: no plan. 1-5: vague optimization. 6-8: stable item identities, measured change detection, pagination or virtualization and keyboard access. 9-11: evidence-led profiling, focus preservation and performance tests.
